title: Inception
description: A skilled thief enters people's dreams to steal secrets and is given a difficult mission to plant an idea inside someone's mind.

title: The Dark Knight
description: Batman faces a dangerous criminal mastermind who creates chaos across Gotham City and pushes the hero to his limits.

title: Interstellar
description: A group of astronauts travels through a wormhole in search of a new home for humanity as Earth becomes increasingly uninhabitable.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
description: A banker sentenced to life in prison forms a powerful friendship and finds hope while enduring years behind bars.

title: Forrest Gump
description: A kind-hearted man with a simple outlook on life unexpectedly becomes part of several major moments in American history.

title: The Matrix
description: A computer programmer discovers that the world he knows is an artificial reality and joins a rebellion against its creators.

title: Titanic
description: Two young people from different social classes fall in love aboard the Titanic shortly before the ship's tragic voyage comes to an end.

title: The Conjuring
description: Paranormal investigators help a family whose new home is haunted by a terrifying supernatural presence.

title: Get Out
description: A young man visits his girlfriend's family and gradually discovers disturbing secrets hidden beneath their seemingly welcoming behavior.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
description: A woman fleeing a tyrannical ruler joins forces with a drifter and a group of rebels in a high-speed fight for freedom.

title: Gladiator
description: A betrayed Roman general becomes a gladiator and seeks revenge against the emperor who destroyed his family and stole his future.

title: The Godfather
description: The aging head of a powerful crime family prepares his reluctant son to take over the family's criminal empire.

title: La La Land
description: An aspiring actress and a passionate jazz musician fall in love while pursuing their dreams in Los Angeles.

title: Toy Story
description: A group of toys comes to life when humans are away, and a cowboy doll struggles to accept the arrival of a new favorite toy.

title: Finding Nemo
description: A timid clownfish travels across the ocean to find his son after the young fish is captured by humans.

title: Coco
description: A young boy who dreams of becoming a musician enters the Land of the Dead and discovers unexpected truths about his family.

title: The Hangover
description: Three friends wake up after a wild bachelor party in Las Vegas and try to piece together what happened during the night.

title: The Grand Budapest Hotel
description: A hotel concierge and his young protégé become involved in a complicated adventure surrounding a stolen painting and a family fortune.

title: Parasite
description: A struggling family gradually becomes involved with a wealthy household, leading to an unexpected and dangerous clash between social classes.

title: The Social Network
description: The story follows the creation of a major social networking platform and the friendships and legal disputes that emerge along the way.

title: Rocky
description: A small-time boxer gets an unexpected opportunity to fight the heavyweight champion and prepares for the biggest challenge of his life.

title: Whiplash
description: A young jazz drummer pushes himself toward greatness under the demanding guidance of an intense and abusive instructor.

title: Spirited Away
description: A young girl enters a mysterious spirit world and must find a way to rescue her transformed parents and return home.

title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: A young hobbit begins a dangerous journey to destroy a powerful ring while being pursued by forces seeking to reclaim it.

title: Jurassic Park
description: A group of visitors explores a theme park filled with genetically recreated dinosaurs before a security failure turns the experience into a fight for survival.

title: Alien
description: A spaceship crew encounters a deadly extraterrestrial creature that begins hunting them one by one.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
description: A young FBI trainee seeks the help of an imprisoned criminal psychologist to catch a dangerous serial killer.

title: Knives Out
description: A detective investigates the mysterious death of a wealthy novelist while uncovering secrets among the victim's family members.

title: The Pursuit of Happyness
description: A struggling father fights poverty while trying to build a better future for himself and his young son.

title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
description: A woman overwhelmed by family and financial problems discovers that she can access versions of herself across multiple parallel universes.
